description: Barcelona speech-technology company whose Speech Center sold STT and TTS (gRPC) for Spanish, Catalan and other languages. Capacity acquired Verbio in August 2025. By 2026-11-18 verbio.com and speechcenter.verbio.com redirect to capacity.com, the developer docs domain no longer resolves and the public SDK repositories are gone, so the API is no longer sold as a separate product. No end date was published.
name: Verbio
